description: Create, extend or refactor a design system (tokens, components, contracts, docs, platform mapping) where the system itself is the work object; pages that only consume the system stay in page and redesign flows.

stages.purpose: Inventory the current tokens, components, consumers, platforms and inconsistencies before proposing any new foundation.

gates.require: existing token sources, component owners, consuming products/screens, supported platforms and themes, and known inconsistencies are explicit; absent sources are recorded as UNKNOWN rather than invented
every changed token path, class name or component API lists its consumers and whether the change is additive, deprecating or breaking

stages.purpose: Define the token architecture and component contracts: primitive to semantic to component layering, roles per mode, states, accessibility semantics and platform mapping.

gates.require: components consume semantic roles only; every role is defined in every supported mode; colour, type, spacing, shape, elevation and motion scales are numeric and traceable to a source or a labelled starting default
each new or changed component records purpose, anatomy, variants, full state coverage, accessibility semantics, content limits, misuse and platform mapping before implementation

stages.purpose: Implement tokens, generated outputs, components, docs specimens and a reference example; keep changes additive or provide a deprecation path.

gates.require: generated outputs are rebuilt from source, validators cover format, layering, mode parity, contrast pairs and literal-free component styles, and a changelog entry states the version impact

stages.purpose: Verify the system as rendered: every component state in light and dark, contrast, focus, reduced motion, cross-browser behaviour and consumer regressions.

gates.require: specimens of every changed component and state are inspected in each supported theme at representative widths; the quality-bar rubric has no hard fail
at least one consuming screen or reference example is re-rendered after the change and shows no unintended regression
automated checks, rendered review, assistive-technology testing and adoption evidence are reported separately; anything not run stays NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN

policies.reason: A rendered state, contrast pair or consumer regressed; repair the owning token or component rather than patching the consumer.
The inventory or consumer map was wrong; re-establish system truth before changing foundations.
A breaking change reached production consumers; add governance and release specialists.
Diagnose the failing build or validator instead of retrying blindly.
Ownership or adoption is blocked; reframe the decision with stakeholders.
